source.english_context: Unit 07 Food, Groceries, and Restaurants Goal: shop for food, order meals, explain allergies, and handle tipping. Daily Life English I am allergic to peanuts. Can I get this without onions? Could we have separate checks? Can I have a box for leftovers? Could I see the menu, please? Is this dish spicy? Does this soup contain milk? Could you check the ingredients for me? I would like a table for two. Can I order this to go? Could we have some water, please? Where can I find fresh vegetables? How much is this per pound? Is a service charge included in the bill? Could I have the dressing on the side? Vocabulary grocery store a store that sells food produce fresh fruits and vegetables allergy a health problem from some food or thing tip extra money for service leftovers food you did not finish separate checks different bills for different people menu a list of food and drinks you can order ingredient one of the foods used to make a dish to go prepared to be taken away and eaten somewhere else reservation an arrangement to hold a table or place for you serving an amount of food intended for one person service charge an extra amount added to a bill for service US Customs In many sit-down restaurants, people usually leave a tip for the server. Taking leftovers home is normal. Ask for a box. Tell restaurant staff about allergies clearly before you order. Dialogue Server: Are you ready to order? Student: Yes. I would like the chicken salad. Server: Any changes? Student: No nuts, please. I have a nut allergy. Server: Thank you for telling me.

japanese_explanation.heading: 食べ物ははっきり伝える
points: アレルギーは遠慮せずに最初に言います。命に関わることがあるので、簡単な英語で強く伝えて大丈夫です。
レストランでは、残り物を持ち帰ることは普通です。box と言えば持ち帰り用の容器を頼めます。
着席式のレストランではチップを払う文化があります。地域や店で期待が違うので、レシートを確認しましょう。

existing_simplified_chinese.heading: 食物需求要说清楚
points: 过敏一定要一开始就说。因为可能有危险，用简单英文明确表达是可以的。
在餐厅把剩菜带回家很正常。说 box 就可以要打包盒。
坐下点餐的餐厅通常有给小费的习惯。不同地区和餐厅期待不同，可以看收据上的提示。

ko.heading: 음식 관련 사항은 명확히 전달하세요
points: 알레르기는 주저하지 말고 처음에 말씀하세요. 생명과 관련될 수 있으므로 간단한 영어로 확실하게 전달해도 괜찮습니다.
레스토랑에서 남은 음식을 포장해 가는 것은 일반적입니다. "box"라고 말하면 포장 용기를 요청할 수 있습니다.
착석식 레스토랑에서는 팁을 지불하는 문화가 있습니다. 지역이나 가게마다 기대치가 다르므로 영수증을 확인하세요.

es.heading: Comunique claramente sobre la comida
points: Informe sobre las alergias sin dudarlo al principio. Como puede ser un riesgo para la vida, está bien comunicarlo con firmeza usando inglés sencillo.
En los restaurantes, es normal llevarse las sobras a casa. Si dice “box” (caja), puede pedir un recipiente para llevar.
En los restaurantes con servicio de mesa, existe la costumbre de dejar propina. Las expectativas varían según la región y el establecimiento, así que revise el recibo.

pt-BR.heading: Comunique claramente sobre a comida
points: Informe sobre alergias sem hesitação logo no início. Como pode ser uma questão de vida ou morte, está tudo bem em comunicar de forma incisiva usando um inglês simples.
Em restaurantes, levar as sobras para casa é comum. Ao dizer “box” (caixa), você pode pedir um recipiente para viagem.
Em restaurantes com serviço de mesa, existe a cultura de dar gorjetas. As expectativas variam por região e estabelecimento, então verifique o recibo.

fr.heading: Communiquez clairement vos besoins alimentaires
points: Signalez vos allergies sans hésitation dès le début. Comme cela peut être vital, vous pouvez le communiquer fermement en anglais simple.
Dans les restaurants, il est normal d'emporter les restes à la maison. En disant “box” (boîte), vous pouvez demander un contenant pour emporter.
Dans les restaurants avec service à table, il est d'usage de laisser un pourboire. Les attentes varient selon la région et l'établissement, alors vérifiez le reçu.

de.heading: Sprechen Sie klar über Essen
points: Geben Sie Allergien ohne Zögern gleich zu Beginn an. Da dies lebensbedrohlich sein kann, ist es in einfachem Englisch in Ordnung, dies nachdrücklich zu kommunizieren.
In Restaurants ist es normal, Reste mit nach Hause zu nehmen. Wenn Sie „box“ (Schachtel) sagen, können Sie einen Behälter zum Mitnehmen anfordern.
In Restaurants mit Tischbedienung gibt es die Kultur, Trinkgeld zu geben. Die Erwartungen variieren je nach Region und Geschäft, überprüfen Sie daher die Quittung.
